name: Copying error
oneLine: A wrong letter slipped into a copy. It is how new variants appear.
howItWorks: No copier is perfect. A few mistakes create variety to choose from. Too many and the message dissolves into noise.
deeper: Manfred Eigen described this limit in 1971 as the error threshold. The longer the message, the more accurate copying must be.
sizeComparison: a 100,000th the width of a hair
simplification: Error rates here are exaggerated so you can see them.
